description: Compares reports of the same check from before and after a change, such as main and a branch, and returns a verdict (IMPROVED, PARTLY_IMPROVED, REGRESSED, MIXED, UNCHANGED, INCONCLUSIVE or NOT_COMPARABLE), what happened to each problem, and a Markdown block for a pull request. A problem counts as gone only when a complete run after the change checked it, so a run that stopped early is never a fix. Give several reports per side for repeated runs.

after.description: Reports of the same check from after the change.

afterLabel.description: Name for the after side, such as the branch.

before.description: Reports from before the change: report.json files or their folders.

beforeLabel.description: Name for the before side, such as main.

name: compare_reports
title: Compare reports from before and after a change
